fixtureGoal: Capture release operator signoff metadata required before an approval decision rehearsal without creating the approval decision or executing deployment, rollback, or SQL.

requiredSignoffFields.name: release-operator
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator records who owns the release signoff before an approval decision can be rehearsed.

requiredSignoffFields.name: rollback-approver
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator records who can approve rollback during this release window.

requiredSignoffFields.name: release-window
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator records the planned release window covered by this signoff.

requiredSignoffFields.name: artifact-target
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator records the exact release tag or artifact version covered by the signoff.

requiredSignoffFields.name: operator-signoff-placeholder
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator records the manual signoff reference outside this fixture.

requiredSignoffFields.name: release-audit-retention-fixture
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator confirms the release audit retention fixture is available for later evidence retention review.

requiredSignoffFields.name: rollback-approver-evidence-fixture
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator confirms rollback approver evidence and SQL/no-SQL boundary before decision rehearsal.

requiredSignoffFields.name: no-secret-value-boundary
requiredSignoffFields.description: Operator confirms this signoff stores metadata only and never embeds secret values.

noSecretValueBoundaries: Secret values must not be read by Java or Node when rendering this signoff
Secret values must not be embedded in release operator signoff JSON
Node may render the approval prerequisite gate only
forbiddenOperations: Creating a real approval decision from this fixture
Writing approval ledger entries from this fixture
Executing Java deployment from this fixture
Executing Java rollback from this fixture
Executing database rollback SQL from this fixture
Connecting production database from this fixture
Reading production secret values from this fixture
Embedding secret values in release operator signoff JSON
